text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby-loving Vodka and the Triple Tiara-set Daiwa Scarlet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Provoked, Vodka decides to run in the Tulip Sho. Maybe it's fate that two rivals on completely different paths meet in an unexpected place like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The days leading up to the race are troubled, as their conversations span from mere insults to serious debates.
